data.change_summary: Applied both pending amendments. (1) Fixed NaN edge case in compute_effective_nitrite_hazard (shrimp.rs:61-73): added early return `if chloride_protection_factor <= 0.0 || chloride_mg_l <= 0.0 { return nitrite_mg_l; }` before the ratio calculation, preventing `0.0 * inf = NaN` when cpf is zero and nitrite is subnormal with large chloride. Also removed now-redundant `.max(0.0)` calls on the remaining path since the guards handle non-positive inputs. (2) Added chloride_mg_per_l and effective_nitrite_hazard_mg_per_l fields to TankSnapshot (snapshot.rs:46-47) and TankSnapshotRepr (with #[serde(default)] for backward compatibility), populated from concentrations and compute_effective_nitrite_hazard in from_state. This makes chloride concentration and effective nitrite hazard visible in the TUI/API chemistry screen between event firings.

steps.description: Added early-return guard in compute_effective_nitrite_hazard (shrimp.rs:69-71): `if chloride_protection_factor <= 0.0 || chloride_mg_l <= 0.0 { return nitrite_mg_l; }`. Removed redundant `.max(0.0)` calls from the remaining code path since both values are now guaranteed positive.

Added chloride_mg_per_l and effective_nitrite_hazard_mg_per_l fields to TankSnapshot struct (snapshot.rs:46-47), TankSnapshotRepr with #[serde(default)] for backward-compatible deserialization (snapshot.rs:109-112), and From<TankSnapshotRepr> impl (snapshot.rs:176-177).

Added import of compute_effective_nitrite_hazard in snapshot.rs and computed both new fields in TankSnapshot::from_state using chemistry.chloride_mg_per_l() and the species-specific chloride_protection_factor from state.shrimp_params.

Verified all existing snapshot tests pass (backward compatibility): snapshot_deserializes_legacy_chemistry_aliases, snapshot_deserializes_pre_stage_payloads_without_stage_totals, snapshot_deserializes_payloads_missing_co2_field, snapshot_deserializes_enriched_api_payload_with_canonical_precedence — all pass because the new fields use #[serde(default)].
